purpose: Converts physical input into rebinding-aware, semantic player actions.
description: Processes semantic player actions from input maps, applies player-mode policy and rebinding, and coordinates client/server action state.

Client/PlayerInputActionModel.luau.description: Binds one semantic action to its reactive InputKeyMapList and coalesces all physical sources into one Begin/End lifecycle. Public entry points include `PlayerInputActionModel.new`, `PlayerInputActionModel.TriggerInput`, `PlayerInputActionModel.IsHeld`, `PlayerInputActionModel.ForceRelease`, `PlayerInputActionModel.RefreshPolicy`, `PlayerInputActionModel.Destroy`.

PlayerInputCooldownService.luau.description: Automatically maps authoritative action cooldowns onto PlayerInputService restrictions and starts them from completed action executions. Public entry points include `PlayerInputCooldownService.Init`, `PlayerInputCooldownService.Start`, `PlayerInputCooldownService.Bind`, `PlayerInputCooldownService.BindAction`, `PlayerInputCooldownService.TryStartActionExecution`, `PlayerInputCooldownService.IsActionOnCooldown`,…

PlayerInputCooldownServiceClient.luau.description: Automatically maps configured replicated or predicted cooldown state onto local PlayerInputServiceClient restrictions. Public entry points include `PlayerInputCooldownServiceClient.Init`, `PlayerInputCooldownServiceClient.Start`, `PlayerInputCooldownServiceClient.Bind`, `PlayerInputCooldownServiceClient.BindAction`, `PlayerInputCooldownServiceClient.IsActionOnCooldown`,…

PlayerInputService.luau.description: Validates compact semantic input reports and provides authoritative contexts, restrictions, server binding overrides, and input observations. Public entry points include `PlayerInputService.Init`, `PlayerInputService.Start`, `PlayerInputService.RegisterActor`, `PlayerInputService.ObserveActorsBrio`, `PlayerInputService.SetGlobalServerInputRateLimit`, `PlayerInputService.SetGlobalNetworkRateLimit`,…

PlayerInputServiceClient.luau.description: Binds the local player's semantic actions, applies local and server policy, and sends only explicitly allowed compact action events. Public entry points include `PlayerInputServiceClient.Init`, `PlayerInputServiceClient.Start`, `PlayerInputServiceClient.ObserveAllInputs`, `PlayerInputServiceClient.ObserveInput`, `PlayerInputServiceClient.IsInputHeld`, `PlayerInputServiceClient.ObserveIsInputHeld`,…

Server/PlayerInputActorModel.luau.description: Owns one Player or NPC Model's authoritative input policy, rate limiters, held action state, and optional player binding overrides. Public entry points include `PlayerInputActorModel.new`, `PlayerInputActorModel.ProcessInput`, `PlayerInputActorModel.TryInput`, `PlayerInputActorModel.PushContext`, `PlayerInputActorModel.PushRestriction`, `PlayerInputActorModel.IsInputHeld`, `PlayerInputActorModel.ForceRelease`,…

Shared/PlayerInputActionConditionModel.l.description: Tracks whether one action's adornee conditions currently permit a player character or NPC actor. Public entry points include `PlayerInputActionConditionModel.new`, `PlayerInputActionConditionModel.AreConditionsMet`, `PlayerInputActionConditionModel.Destroy`.

Shared/PlayerInputActionProvider.luau.description: Defines a game's semantic input actions and publishes their InputKeyMapLists to the existing keymap registry. Public entry points include `PlayerInputActionProvider.new`, `PlayerInputActionProvider.Init`, `PlayerInputActionProvider.Start`, `PlayerInputActionProvider.AddAction`, `PlayerInputActionProvider.AddContext`, `PlayerInputActionProvider.GetProviderName`, `PlayerInputActionProvider.GetAction`,…

Shared/PlayerInputActionRegistryServiceS.description: Registers PlayerInputActionProvider instances and validates the shared action catalog on both realms. Public entry points include `PlayerInputActionRegistryServiceShared.Init`, `PlayerInputActionRegistryServiceShared.Start`, `PlayerInputActionRegistryServiceShared.RegisterProvider`, `PlayerInputActionRegistryServiceShared.GetActionById`, `PlayerInputActionRegistryServiceShared.GetAction`,…

Shared/PlayerInputActorUtils.luau.description: Validates actors accepted by the authoritative PlayerInputService. Public entry points include `PlayerInputActorUtils.isInputActor`.

Shared/PlayerInputCooldownServiceConstan.description: Defaults for the optional PlayerInput cooldown integration.

Shared/PlayerInputCooldownServiceTypes.l.description: Configuration contracts for the optional PlayerInput cooldown services.

Shared/PlayerInputCooldownServiceUtils.l.description: Validates configuration for the optional PlayerInput cooldown services. Public entry points include `isActionList`, `PlayerInputCooldownServiceUtils.isActionCooldownConfigured`, `PlayerInputCooldownServiceUtils.getActionCooldownDefinition`, `PlayerInputCooldownServiceUtils.shouldStartActionCooldown`, `PlayerInputCooldownServiceUtils.isServerBindingConfig`, `PlayerInputCooldownServiceUtils.getServerBindingActor`,…

Shared/PlayerInputPolicyModel.luau.description: Resolves priority contexts and per-action restriction overlays for one local or server-owned actor policy. Public entry points include `PlayerInputPolicyModel.new`, `PlayerInputPolicyModel.PushContext`, `PlayerInputPolicyModel.PushRestriction`, `PlayerInputPolicyModel.IsActionAllowed`, `PlayerInputPolicyModel.GetActionDenialResult`, `PlayerInputPolicyModel.IsActionAllowedForPlayerMode`,…

Shared/PlayerInputResults.luau.description: Canonical results returned by authoritative actor input attempts.

Shared/PlayerInputServiceConstants.luau.description: Protocol and policy constants for PlayerInputService.

Shared/PlayerInputServiceNetwork.luau.description: Compact semantic input protocol for PlayerInputService. Clients can only send an action ID and Begin/End state.

Shared/PlayerInputServiceTypes.luau.description: Shared contracts for PlayerInputService actions, contexts, restrictions, and binding overrides.

Shared/PlayerInputServiceUtils.luau.description: Validates PlayerInputService definitions and converts keymap values to compact, network-safe binding records. Public entry points include `createStringSet`, `inferPlayerInputModes`, `isKnownPlayerInputMode`, `isPositiveFiniteNumber`, `createCooldownValue`, `PlayerInputServiceUtils.getActionKey`, `PlayerInputServiceUtils.createAction`, `PlayerInputServiceUtils.toNetworkStateCode`.

Shared/PlayerInputStates.luau.description: Input lifecycle states emitted by PlayerInputService.
